name: Restorative Dentistry
shortDescription: Fillings, crowns, bridges, inlays and onlays to repair and replace teeth.

seo.title: Restorative Dentistry in Santa Clarita | Dr. Lavi
seo.description: Fillings, crowns, bridges, inlays and onlays from Dr. Nuriel Lavi in Santa Clarita. Same-day crowns, biocompatible materials and sedation options.

hero.lead: Repair damaged teeth and replace missing ones with restorations that look and feel natural. Dr. Lavi plans each one personally in our Valencia office.

intro.heading: What restorative dentistry means here
paragraphs: Restorative dentistry repairs teeth that are decayed, cracked or worn and replaces teeth that are missing. It covers tooth-colored fillings, custom crowns, bridges, inlays and onlays and dental implants. The goal is simple: give you back comfortable chewing, a stable bite and a smile that looks like your own. Dr. Lavi chooses the most conservative option that will do the job well.

Because he practices holistically, Dr. Lavi favors biocompatible materials such as composite resin, porcelain and zirconia, and he keeps as much healthy tooth structure as possible. Crowns can be made in-house, often in a single visit, and the iTero digital scanner replaces messy impressions. You see Dr. Lavi at every appointment, and same-day care is available when a tooth breaks or starts to hurt.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.intro: Restorative care may be right for you if any of these sound familiar.
items: Older dental work that is failing or needs replacement
Pain or sensitivity when you chew
A bite that feels uneven or teeth that are shifting
A preference for durable solutions that look and feel natural

benefits.heading: What good restorations give back
benefits.intro: Well-made restorations do more than fix a single tooth.

items.title: Comfortable chewing
items.text: Repairing or replacing damaged teeth restores function so you can eat without hesitation.

items.title: Stronger teeth
items.text: Crowns, onlays and fillings reinforce weakened structure and help prevent further breakage.

items.title: Natural appearance
items.text: Materials matched to your tooth color blend in, so the work goes unnoticed.

items.title: Clearer speech and a balanced bite
items.text: Filling gaps and rebuilding worn surfaces helps your teeth meet evenly and your speech stay clear.

items.title: Protection for the future
items.text: Treating problems early can head off larger issues such as infection or tooth loss.

items.title: Facial support
items.text: Replacing missing teeth helps maintain the natural shape and balance of your face.

options.heading: Our restorative services
options.intro: Each service repairs a different degree of damage, and Dr. Lavi matches the treatment to the tooth.

items.title: Tooth-colored composite fillings
items.text: Resin fillings matched to your tooth shade and bonded in place, for decay or minor damage.

items.title: Custom dental crowns
items.text: Porcelain or zirconia caps that restore strength and shape to a compromised tooth; often made in-house the same day.

items.title: Dental bridges
items.text: A fixed restoration that fills a gap using the neighboring teeth or implants for support.

items.title: Inlays and onlays
items.text: Lab-made restorations for damage too large for a filling but not needing a full crown, preserving more natural tooth.

process.heading: How treatment works
process.intro: Every plan starts with a careful look at the whole picture.

steps.title: Comprehensive exam
steps.text: Dr. Lavi examines your teeth and gums, takes digital X-rays and uses an intraoral camera so you can see what he sees. 3D imaging is added when planning implants or more complex cases.

steps.title: A plan you understand
steps.text: He explains each option, from the most conservative to the most durable, and you receive a written estimate. You decide together, without pressure.

steps.title: Treatment, comfortably
steps.text: Local anesthesia and sedation options when appropriate keep you at ease. Crowns can often be scanned, designed and placed in a single visit.

steps.title: Ongoing maintenance
steps.text: Regular checkups let Dr. Lavi monitor your restorations and catch wear early so they continue to serve you well.

technology.heading: Tools that make restorations precise
technology.intro: Digital planning and in-house fabrication mean fewer visits and a closer fit.

items.title: iTero digital scanner
items.text: A quick digital scan replaces goopy impressions and captures your teeth in fine detail.

items.title: In-house custom crowns
items.text: Crowns designed and milled on site, so many patients leave with a permanent crown the same day.

items.title: 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: Three-dimensional views of teeth, bone and nerves for planning implants and complex restorations.

items.title: Intraoral cameras and digital X-rays
items.text: Clear images that help you see the problem and understand the fix.

cost.heading: Cost and financing
cost.text: Restorative treatment ranges from a single filling to a full set of restorations, so costs vary widely. What stays constant is how we handle it: after your exam, Dr. Lavi walks you through each option and you receive a written estimate before any treatment begins. Most major PPO plans, including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna, Aetna and Humana, cover restorative care that is medically necessary, and our team reviews your benefits so you understand your share. Flexible financing is available, and new patients can begin with the $59 exam and X-ray special.

faqs.q: What procedures are considered restorative dentistry?
faqs.a: Restorative dentistry includes any treatment that rebuilds the structure and function of a damaged or missing tooth. At Valencia Dentistry that means tooth-colored fillings, custom crowns, bridges, inlays and onlays and dental implants. Dr. Lavi recommends the most conservative option that will hold up well over time.

faqs.q: How long do dental restorations last?
faqs.a: It depends on the restoration, the material and how well it is cared for. With good hygiene and regular checkups, crowns and bridges often last 10 to 15 years or longer. Composite fillings may need replacement sooner, depending on wear and where they sit in the mouth.

Restorative procedures are done under local anesthesia, so the area is fully numb while Dr. Lavi works. If you feel anxious, sedation options are available. Most patients describe mild sensitivity for a day or two afterward rather than pain, and it usually settles on its own.

Most dental insurance plans cover restorative procedures that are medically necessary, though the percentage varies by plan and by procedure. We accept most major PPO plans, and our team will review your benefits, explain what is covered and give you a clear estimate of out-of-pocket costs before treatment.

faqs.q: What if I haven't seen a dentist in years?
faqs.a: You are welcome here, and you are not alone. Many of our patients are returning to dental care after a long gap. Dr. Lavi starts with a thorough, judgment-free exam, explains what he finds in plain language and helps you prioritize treatment at a pace and budget that work for you.

cta.heading: Let's restore your smile
cta.text: Book a consultation at our Valencia office and Dr. Lavi will show you what is possible, one tooth at a time.
